title: Intervention-conditioned causal state refinement and genuine structural cold transfer
contributor: isolated ChatGPT research contributor to sole Amalgam PR #1278

source_provenance.native_input: binary paired public views, binary x1/s2/x2/y; fixed two-stage DTR
source_provenance.native_cumulative: one existing native cumulative learner, no rival coordinator or memory writer
predecessors: SRL01 scientific NO_GO: exact Bayesian posterior/action tie for all 5,832 witness histories
CKAD49: 16-hypothesis grammar retains generating truth, source dev NO_GO
WSP182: linear structural reconstruction ties fully fitted conventional matrix inverse
NCI-NOVEL-07: A/B/A cold recall and matched HMM development already present
CSMC01: 20/50 replay selector misses stage1/stage2 probability fidelity limits

question: Can a single native learner invent a new causally meaningful partition from public intervention consequences, retain old A through B and cold restore, and transfer local causal mechanisms to unfamiliar graph topology more efficiently than fully trained matched conventional controls?

mechanism_contract.objective: induce a minimal local intervention-distinguishable causal state split and graph edge/operator from witness history, not selection among a fixed true-law roster
never_model_inputs: regime ID or source ID as predictive feature
steps: Record immutable source-pinned public action-consequence evidence in the SAME existing native cumulative checkpoint
Represent current causal states as equivalence classes of predicted outcomes under each supported public intervention

On supported contradiction, propose a minimal local state split only if independent *public intervention contrast* can falsify pooled predictive state; otherwise abstain rather than infer hidden context from stochastic noise
Retain the original operator and all source-provenance witnesses; test repair by prospective outcomes before enabling its readout
Compose learned local operators in novel variable-arity topology without receiving graph role mapping, source phase, or new topology label
Cold restore and verify old A, learned B and unfamiliar-transfer readouts and decisions, not checkpoint bytes alone
mechanism_contract.limits: Opt-in sketch within the existing native learner; never create a competing controller, new canonical checkpoint, or unlimited learner

phases.name: P0
phases.scope: exact Markov-equivalence identifiability proof, native source/API feasibility, unit-only controls; no real source stepping

phases.name: P1
phases.scope: small opt-in source-visible native adapter, cold restore, no trial scoring/first-use; no accepted ref write

phases.name: P2
phases.scope: owner-pinned disjoint original multi-topology intervention acquisition, cold A-B-A and transfer with matched arms; current source issue #426 disallows

protocol_to_freeze_before_any_P2.source: Genuine public multi-topology/multi-intervention original source/API license and exact commit are not yet independently identified; binary DTR alone cannot establish new graph-topology transfer
protocol_to_freeze_before_any_P2.split: fit 60%, unfamiliar WORLD/TOPOLOGY transfer 20%, cold-return 20%; prevent isomorphic graph and causal-role overlap leakage; source owner must pin exact split/seeds before first use
protocol_to_freeze_before_any_P2.budget: same observed public histories, charged action opportunities, source interaction budget, adaptation steps, compute and input availability across arms; no evaluator counterfactuals fed to learner
controls: full exact Bayesian structural program inference over the same candidate operator/graph constructible scope, whenever tractable
fully trained Bayesian HMM/change-point with learned emissions and transitions
fully trained variable-depth context-tree / predictive-state and nonparametric conditional models
fully fitted structure learning with regularized graph search
native cumulative/Quine retention, full-history episodic retrieval, no-split and shuffled-intervention ablations
evaluator-only oracle graph upper bound (not eligible for gain)

thresholds.structural_transfer_brier: at least 0.020 absolute improvement over strongest eligible, fully trained matched control, with independent source-custody and no weaker action reward
thresholds.cold_max_brier_drift: <=+0.020 on EACH frozen old-A Quine/old regime and aggregate after B and cold restore
thresholds.intervention_efficiency: >=20% fewer charged interventions to reach identical predeclared performance without reward loss
thresholds.resources: native end-to-end CPU and peak RAM each <=2x accepted baseline under identical runner/harness
thresholds.replication: at least three disjoint original source-qualified topology families/cohorts, independent repetition, full exact-final Linux and Windows regressions
thresholds.falsification: tie/loss to strongest matched control, incorrect source identity, inability to identify topology, cold drift or budget excess => NO_GO

source_first_use.reason: Issue #426 says protected new original-world first-use NOT authorized; no new seed reservation, source action, runner dispatch, merge or deployment

negative_controls: observationally equivalent causal graphs without intervention -> abstain
stochastic source contradiction without public causal discriminator -> abstain
unknown action role mapping without witnessed correspondence -> abstain
no extra hidden graph identity or evaluator target truth
old checkpoint Quine preservation and tamper/replay denial
reporting: ENGINEERING tests distinct from SCIENTIFIC superiority and DEPLOYMENT; never infer model gain from preregistration or CI
